sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for 234010 (catx.py, read 2026-10-22)

values.note: $17 a night per single site; $5 per extra vehicle a night (first two free); double occupancy charged for more than one camping unit on a site. Self-serve fee station takes cash or check only.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/lodgepole-campground ('Single Site: $17 per night', 'Additional Vehicle: $5 per night'; last updated September 1, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234010/rates (2026 Peak Season and First-come, First-served Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 17) + rec.gov notice on double occupancy and extra vehicles, read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 234010 (all 19 reservable sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, electricity 'N/A'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The official counts disagree: rec.gov's description says 29 units (19 reservable, 10 first-come), its notice 30 (19 and 11), and the Forest Service page '31 reservable sites'. FS: 'We recommend trailer lengths do not exceed 32 feet.' The catalog gives no per-site lengths.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/lodgepole-campground ('31 reservable sites', 'We recommend trailer lengths do not exceed 32 feet') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234010 ('29 units available for tent and RV camping. 19 sites can be reserved ... and 10 sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; notice 'There are 30 campsites. 19 sites are reservable and 11 sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No dump station on site; the closest is in Anaconda. Bear-resistant storage lockers; firewood; garbage service.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/lodgepole-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available at this site', 'garbage services') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234010 (notice 'No dump station on site; closest facility is in Anaconda'; amenities Drinking Water, Firewood, Vault Toilets), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Open annually from mid-May through late September, weather dependent.'

19 sites reservable on recreation.gov in summer, the rest first-come (rec.gov runs a first-come season in late September); reservations close 4 days before arrival. 3-night minimum on holiday weekends. 16-day stay limit, 32 nights a year. Check-in 2 p.m., check-out 11 a.m.; a reserved site not occupied by 11 a.m. the next day is released. Run by the Forest Service's Pintler Ranger District, with a campground host.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234010 (rules reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, maxConsecutiveStay 16, maxStay 32 'Each Year'; notices on stay limit, check-in/out and holding reserved sites) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234010/rates ('First-come, First-served Season 2026-09-21 2026-10-01') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/beaverhead-deerlodge/recreation/lodgepole-campground ('Reservations available at rec.gov', '16 day stay limit'), read 2026-10-22

note: Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF campground on MT-1 across the highway from Georgetown Lake, ~11 mi S of Philipsburg at ~6,400 ft; no direct lake access, but the Red Bridge boat launch and fishing access across the road are free to campers. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov: confirmed $17 (2026), no electric, 32-ft trailer recommendation, reservable with some FCFS sites, no dump. Added season (mid-May to late September, no dates), vault toilets/potable water, 4-day reservation cutoff, 3-night holiday minimum, 16-day limit. Site count left at 29 (official pages say 29, 30 and 31; recorded in sites.note). Water/sewer 'false' left derived (pages silent beyond nonelectric). Note trimmed.
